---
name: cli-standard
description: Conventions for commands and health checks in this project.
---
# CLI standard

When adding a health check, name the public function `check_health`. It must return a dictionary with exactly `status` and `service` keys. Use `status='ok'` and `service='codeforge-demo'`. Public functions require a concise docstring.

# Service

Project-specific development conventions are available in the repository.

turns.prompt: 请按照这个仓库已有的开发约定，在 health 模块补上服务健康检查，并确认实现符合项目约定。不要另起一套命名或返回格式。
